summary: The w10b high issue is fixed. The spine now ends at the aisle cap's inner face: the spine runs to x 0.49 and the rail to 0.4915, 4 mm below the cap top at 1.14. The plaques flank the finger recess, so the order on the cap is 17E, recess/spine, 18D, as in c_27313 (own renders v2/v4/v5). The rail is now light brushed metal, and both housing tops carry the light metal edge strips from c_27313/15, so the w10a medium is fixed too. What remains: (1) Proportion of the aisle-end cap. In c_27313 the spine Ts into the cap at its exact centre, with the plaques at the two ends. Ours meets the cap at about 80 % of its length (the cap runs z -0.58..0.035, the spine is at -0.0875), so the 0.37 m over the door pocket is an empty slab and the plaque group is bunched at the E end. (2) The O comforter still reads as crumpled satin with no visible quilting: r9 differs from w10s in only 4.8 % of pixels. (3) The ash grain measurement did not move with gain 3.4 (q06 0.053 vs 0.051, q10 0.065 vs 0.064; photos 0.09-0.16). (4) The cap is too light against the ash (0.92 luma ratio vs 0.58 in c_27313), and the plaque tiles are near-black where the photos show grey tiles. Clearly the same product from the aisle (q06, q09, q10), with several small visible mismatches up close.

issues.problem: The cap and ash post span z -0.58..0.035 (09c line 417, ez0/ez1). The spine is at mz = -0.0875, and both plaques are packed within 0.2 m of the E end (v2_cap_top: cap 20-580 px, plaques 388/545, recess 465). The O end of the cap is a 0.37 m blank slab. In c_27313 the cap reads 17E at the left end, spine fillet at the centre, recess just right of it, 18D at the right end. The spine also butts the cap with a plain end, where the photo shows a flared T fillet.
issues.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/w11b/v2_cap_top.png vs /tmp/claude-0/w11b/c13crop.png (c_27313 crop 280-660 x 250-460: cap 70-670, spine 370, recess 475, plaques ~125 and ~610).
issues.fix: Cheapest step, keeping the monument: 09_seats.js ~line 270 (shared, one line): put the plaques at the cap ends, s.odd ? -0.53 : -0.005, so the composition is plaque / blank / spine+recess / plaque. 09c line 423: move the recess to z mz + 0.045 so it sits between the spine and the E plaque, as in the photo. Add a fillet where the spine meets the cap, e.g. B.add(gRBox(0.05, 0.03, 0.07, 0.012, 1), M4.trs(0.47, MON.top + 0.035, mz), shell), a short flared block. Proper fix (owner's call; see questions): make the aisle-end post symmetric about the monument split.

issues.detail: The O comforter still shows no quilting and remains crumpled satin
issues.problem: foldK 0.35 barely changed r9 (4.8 % px). The head roll (0.012 + 0.008 bump) and the remaining fold ridges still beat the 2 cm stitch dip. With gx = x - xc + 0.07 at xc -0.12, the stitch lines fall at x ≈ -0.40, -0.07 and 0.26, at the sheet edges or under the pillow, so no interior line crosses the visible O sheet.
issues.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/w11s/r9_bedO_close.png vs /tmp/claude-0/w10s/r9_bedO_close.png; tpg_72 shows clear ~0.3 m box quilting across the comforter.
issues.fix: 09c line 307: phase the grid per part, e.g. gx = x - xc + (hd > 0 ? -0.05 : 0.07), so that an O stitch line runs at x ≈ -0.17, mid-sheet. Deepen the dip for O: pass a qK param, 0.024 - 0.020*qK*exp(...) with qK 1.3, and widen the dip (dq/0.03). Drop the O foldK to 0.2.
